# Maxim Autos

> Maxim Autos is a used car dealer in Skokie, Illinois. No dealer fees at Maxim Autos, ever. The price you see is the price you pay, plus tax, title, and license. Rated 5.0 on Google from 54 reviews. 15 cars in stock today, priced $6,450 to $16,450.

Key facts: Maxim Autos, 9101 Terminal Ave, Skokie, IL 60077. (847) 510-8947, call or text. Illinois Secretary of State Class D Used Vehicle Dealer, license DL7667. Hours: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday 3pm to 7pm; Saturday 10am to 3pm; Wednesday by appointment; Sunday closed. Inventory is managed in DealerCenter, the dealership system of record, and this site updates from that live feed several times a day. The site is available in English and in Spanish at https://www.maximautos.com/es.

Every car inspected. Every price transparent. Every car documented.

## What Makes Maxim Autos Different

- No dealer fees at Maxim Autos, ever. The price you see is the price you pay, plus tax, title, and license. No doc fee and no processing fee.
- Rated 5.0 on Google from 54 reviews.
- Every car is inspected before it goes on the lot, and a free CARFAX comes with it. Ask Jerry what was checked on any car before you decide.
- Metal plates issued the same visit, for cars registered in Illinois. If you are registering in another state we issue an Illinois drive away permit instead and you plate the car at home. Maxim Autos is an Illinois CVR (Computer Vehicle Registration) dealer, authorized by the Illinois Secretary of State.
- Illinois 15 day / 500 mile statutory powertrain protection on qualifying cars. Extended coverage is available as an option at signing; ask Jerry for pricing when you visit.
- Financing for all credit levels, including buyers building or rebuilding their credit. Approval is never guaranteed.
- The owner, Jerry Franco, personally selects and sources every vehicle at auction. Buyers deal directly with the owner, not a commissioned salesperson.
- Serving Chicago's North Shore: Evanston, Niles, Morton Grove, Lincolnwood, Des Plaines, Glenview, Wilmette, Skokie, Park Ridge.

## Disclosures

- Our cars are sold AS IS.
- Illinois 15 day / 500 mile statutory powertrain protection on qualifying cars. Statutory exclusions: over 150,000 miles, rebuilt or flood title, GVWR at or above 8,000 lb, antique or collector.
- Approval is never guaranteed.
- * Est. payment based on 10% down, 9.9% APR, 60-month term. For illustrative purposes only. Actual terms vary by credit.
